_note: Skill list for the portal Resources page. Updated 2 Oct 2026 to match the skills Ella runs now. An empty description or download means it has not been written or uploaded yet.

skills.name: security-superhuman
skills.description: Walks you through three Claude settings and reports the counts back. Do it before you connect anything.

skills.name: superhuman
skills.description: Locks your 90-day goal, pulls context from your connectors, shows your time sinks and produces a ranked build list.

skills.name: compass-superhuman
skills.description: Builds your Business COMPASS from your own calls, docs, email and Notion, fills the gaps with a short interview, then runs a Time Rich audit of where your time goes.

skills.name: audit-superhuman
skills.description: Counts projects, skills, scheduled tasks, prompts and chat habits; scores Live, Dead, Duplicate, Habit; maturity 1 to 5 from what ran; skills to build capped at 5.

skills.name: replies-superhuman
skills.description: Clusters the replies you keep writing, cuts the yeses that work against the Goal, pulls your voice from sent mail, and writes a reply skill for your chief of staff agent. Drafts only.

skills.name: revenue-superhuman
skills.description: Revenue map by offer and per hour, the one lever, the leak, 10 ideas through three filters, a Moves list capped at 5.

skills.name: hooks-superhuman
skills.description: One platform, business or personal, the three calls that went best; 10 hooks with reaction evidence, 10 open loops, 5 drafts. Never posts.

skills.name: story-superhuman
skills.description: Story bank of 8 to 15 from six transcripts, business arc and personal arc in five beats, slots table, Founder Story under 300 words.

skills.name: superhuman-delegate
skills.description: Daily and weekly rhythm: turns a morning voice note into briefed tasks, handles a brief someone gives you, and runs the Friday review.

skills.name: follow-up-agent
skills.description: Builds, tests and runs a meeting follow-up agent that drafts follow-up emails from your calendar and notetaker notes.

skills.name: channels-superhuman
skills.description: Maps which platforms actually serve your Goal, then cuts one source (a newsletter, talk or hook bank) into platform-native drafts with one CTA each.

skills.name: cta-superhuman
skills.description: Keeps your CTA library in Notion, picks the one CTA a post should carry, checks the link is live, and writes a CTA when none exists.

skills.name: build-icp-from-calls
skills.description: Builds or sharpens your ideal client profile from recorded Granola calls, and pulls stories and ideas into a Notion Ideas + Story Bank.

skills.name: content-guardrails-superhuman
skills.description: Interviews you about what is and isn't appropriate to pull from your call notes, then writes the guardrails every content skill follows.

skills.name: audit-linkedin-for-icp-goal
skills.description: Audits a LinkedIn profile against one 90-day goal and one ideal client: asks goal and ICP first, scores 27 checks, returns ranked fixes with drafts.
